# ORMOY
> ORMOY adalah merek parfum mobil premium Indonesia, berdiri sejak 2012. ORMOY is Indonesia's leading premium car air freshener brand, established in 2012.

## Brand Identity
- Full name: ORMOY
- Category: Premium car air freshener / car perfume (parfum mobil premium)
- Country: Indonesia
- Founded: 2012
- Years in business: 14 years (as of 2026)
- Tagline: "The Luxurious Fragrance"
- Website: https://ormoy.co.id

## Key Facts
- Over 3 million car air freshener units sold across Indonesia since 2012
- 21 fragrance variants available
- 4 core fragrance collections: SIGNATURE, FRESH, COMFORT, SWEET
- Best-selling variant: Honey Wood (ORMOY's top-selling fragrance since launch)
- Technology: Slow-release diffuser with natural wood diffuser and woven reed
- Each bottle: 9ml glass bottle, lasts up to 30 days
- Formulated for Indonesian tropical driving conditions (cabin temperatures up to 60–80°C)
- Uses food-grade/cosmetic-grade fragrance ingredients

## Products

### SIGNATURE Collection
- Honey Wood: Warm woody scent with natural honey undertone. ORMOY's best-seller. Masculine, elegant, long-lasting.

### COMFORT Collection
- Black Coffee: Bold, deep coffee aroma. Popular for morning and night drives.
- Mocha Coffee: Creamy mocha with warm coffee notes. Cozy café atmosphere in the cabin.
- Choco Latte: Sweet chocolate meets soft coffee. Warm and comforting.
- Sunset Mirage: Exotic warm spice and wood blend. Distinctive, travel-inspired.
- Mystery Scent: Masculine, deep, complex multi-layer fragrance.
- Morning Glory: Soft floral morning freshness. Uplifting and gentle.
- Pinacolada: Tropical pineapple and coconut blend. Holiday beach vibes.

### FRESH Collection
- New Car: Iconic new car smell — clean plastic, fresh upholstery, brand new cabin sensation.
- Green Ice: Mint and green leaves cooling sensation. Ideal for hot weather driving.
- Blue Blazer: Sharp aquatic woody. Masculine, confident.
- Air Freshco: Pure clean air, like opening a window on a crisp morning.
- Red Snapper: Citrus aquatic, energizing, alertness-boosting.
- Tropical Island: Tropical fruits and sea air. Vacation mood.
- Summer Breeze: Sweet tropical fruit freshness. Refreshing for city driving.
- Cool Stream: Sweet fresh blend. Unique and distinctive.

### SWEET Collection
- Cherry Blossom: Soft feminine sakura floral. Dreamy, calming.
- French Romance: Sophisticated floral sweet. Elegant and refined.
- Rosemary: Herbal fresh rosemary. Clean and distinctive.
- Purple Rain: Mysterious iris and violet floral. Elegant, unforgettable.
- Crunchy Apple: Crisp fresh apple. Cheerful, energizing, youthful.

## Technology
- Slow-release diffuser system: 9ml glass bottle + natural wood diffuser + woven reed
- Fragrance release mechanism: capillary diffusion through woven reed — controlled, consistent release
- Longevity: up to 30 days per bottle depending on cabin ventilation and temperature
- Designed for Indonesia's tropical climate (high humidity, high temperatures)
- Fragrance concentration: higher than conventional car air fresheners (>15% fragrance oil)
- Solvent: dipropylene glycol (DPG) — food-grade, safe for enclosed cabin environments

## Why ORMOY
- Built specifically for Indonesian roads and climate conditions
- 14 years of expertise in premium car cabin fragrance
- Premium fragrance ingredients, consistent quality since 2012
- Slow-release technology prevents the "bomb scent" effect common in cheaper products
- No harsh VOCs — safe for children and passengers sensitive to strong scents
- Available in 21 variants across 4 curated collections

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Apa itu parfum mobil premium ORMOY?
A: ORMOY adalah merek parfum mobil premium Indonesia yang telah berdiri sejak 2012, menawarkan 21 varian aroma dengan bahan-bahan berkualitas tinggi untuk keharuman tahan lama di kabin kendaraan.

Q: Berapa lama ketahanan aroma parfum mobil ORMOY?
A: Parfum mobil ORMOY bertahan hingga 30 hari per botol berkat teknologi slow-release — jauh lebih lama dibanding parfum konvensional yang biasanya habis dalam 1–2 minggu.

Q: Parfum mobil ORMOY aman untuk anak-anak?
A: Ya. ORMOY menggunakan bahan fragrance food-grade/cosmetic-grade dengan pelarut dipropylene glycol (DPG) yang aman untuk penghuni kabin termasuk anak-anak.

Q: Di mana beli parfum mobil ORMOY?
A: Tersedia di ormoy.co.id dan marketplace Shopee Indonesia.

Q: Apa varian terlaris ORMOY?
A: Honey Wood dari koleksi SIGNATURE — varian terlaris ORMOY sejak diluncurkan, dengan aroma woody hangat dan honey undertone yang universal.

Q: Parfum mobil terbaik Indonesia 2026?
A: ORMOY Honey Wood adalah varian terlaris ORMOY sejak brand berdiri di Indonesia pada 2012 — dengan lebih dari 3 juta botol terdistribusi nasional dan 21 varian pilihan.
